“儿啊，你好好想一想，到底是怎么回事？怎么就突然晕倒了？晕倒之前有没有什么事情发生？”

赵支书皱着眉头，开口问道。

“好像……好像脖子后面突然疼了一下，然后就不知道了。”歪着嘴的赵霸想了想后，开口道。

“唉……！”

赵支书长长吸了一口烟，脸上满是愁容，自家怎么就遇到这种事情了呢？

“对了，儿子，你这个应该不影响生育吧？”

“爹，怎么会影响生育？我现在只是嘴歪，瞎眼，跛脚而已！”赵霸连忙开口解释道。

“那就好，那就好！”

听到自家儿子这么说，赵支书这才长呼一口气道：“要是这样的话，你的婚事就不能拖延太长时间了，得尽快办了才是，早些给爹生个孙子！”

“爹，王春晓现在和李青山那小狗崽子打的火热呢，咱们家要是提出尽早完婚得话，这个狗崽子肯定会跳出来捣乱，毕竟现在婚姻自由，你还是村支书，影响不好。”

赵霸开口道。

“咋了，你得意思是，换一个媳妇？”赵支书问道。

“不换！”

“我就看中春晓了，其他谁都不行。”

“我的意思是，咱们要是将李青山这个麻烦给解决掉，王春晓必然死心，到时候你再对王守业施加施加压力。”

“哼，王春晓那个小丫头，怎么可能逃得出咱们父子俩的手掌心？”

赵霸眼神中流露出一抹冷意道。

“怎么解决掉？”赵支书微微一怔，再次问道。

“爹，这点小事情你怎么都想不明白？李青山这个小崽子不是经常上山打猎吗？老林子里面可不安生，咱们这十里八乡的，哪一年不死上几个人？我听说李青山和大壮这伙人，手中也就一把单管猎枪，还是从柔雪那个小寡妇手中坑蒙拐骗来的。”

“咱们去隔壁村子联系几个猎人，只要李青山这几个家伙上山，就让隔壁村的猎人也跟着一起上去，李青山这小崽子能有什么老林子里面的经验，到时候弄死他们还不是轻轻松松？”

“而且，人死在老林子里面，尸体都不会有，直接就是个失踪，就是政府也不会管，死了也白死，等到李青山死了后，那王春晓还能不乖乖就范吗？”

"Son, think about it carefully, what happened? Why did you faint suddenly? Did anything happen before you fainted?"

Secretary Zhao frowned and asked.

"It seems...it seems like the back of my neck suddenly hurts, and then I don't know." Zhao Ba, who tilted his mouth, thought for a while and said.

"Alas...!"

Secretary Zhao took a long drag on his cigarette, his face full of sadness. Why did this happen to his family?

"By the way, son, this shouldn't affect your fertility, right?"

"Dad, how could it affect fertility? I'm just crooked, blind, and lame now!" Zhao Ba quickly explained.

"That's good, that's good!"

Hearing what his son said, Party Secretary Zhao took a long breath and said: "If this is the case, your marriage cannot be delayed for too long. It must be done as soon as possible. Give dad a grandson as soon as possible!"

"Dad, Wang Chunxiao is currently having a fierce fight with that little brat Li Qingshan. If our family proposes to get married as soon as possible, this brat will definitely jump out and cause trouble. After all, marriage is free now, and you are still the village party secretary, so the influence will not be good."

Zhao Ba said.

"What's wrong, do you mean to change to another wife?" Party Secretary Zhao asked.

"Don't change!"

"I only like Chunxiao, no one else can."

"What I mean is that if we solve the problem of Li Qingshan, Wang Chunxiao will definitely give up. Then you will put pressure on Wang Shouye again."

"Hmph, how could that little girl Wang Chunxiao escape from the clutches of our father and son?"

Zhao Ba said with a hint of coldness in his eyes.

"How to solve it?" Secretary Zhao was slightly startled and asked again.

"Dad, why can't you understand this little thing? Doesn't this kid Li Qingshan often go hunting in the mountains? There is no life in the old forest. How many people from all over the country don't die every year? I heard that Li Qingshan and Da Zhuang's group only have a single-barreled shotgun in their hands, and they got it from the little widow Rouxue."

"Let's go to the next village to contact some hunters. As long as Li Qingshan and these guys go up the mountain, let the hunters from the next village go up with them. What experience does Li Qingshan have in the old forest? Isn't it easy to kill them by then?"

"Moreover, if a person dies in the old forest, there will be no body. He will simply disappear. Even the government will not care about it. His death will be in vain. After Li Qingshan dies, can Wang Chunxiao not submit obediently?"
